capabilities: Render .html/.htm vault files in a sandboxed live preview
Route page fetch() calls through Obsidian's request engine to bypass CORS
Debug pages with in-page Eruda console, elements, and network panels
Toggle a syntax-highlighted source view for quick edits
Inline relative CSS, JS, and images so pages render standalone
extras: Not yet on the community plugin list; must be installed via BRAT or manually, and the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. DevTools panel requires network access to load Eruda from a CDN, though offline preview of local files still works.
problem: Obsidian does not render HTML files as live pages or let local pages call internet APIs without CORS errors.

relations.evidence: Inline DevTools loads Eruda from cdn.jsdelivr.net
BRAT — add this repo (d0uub/obsidian-html-viewer) via Add a beta plugin

summary: HTML file viewer that renders .html/.htm files in a live preview tab with Eruda DevTools, a source editor, and a CORS-free fetch bridge.
